about_the_game:
《2 Hours Later 》 is a third person shooter game where players will use various firearms such as handguns, shotguns, assault rifles, and sniper rifles to deal with the zombie virus outbreak crisis.

Game Mode 1-Survival mode：

Defend your home in a post apocalyptic city filled with zombies. During the day, you need to go out and search for various supplies such as building materials, food, and weapons. Of course, you will encounter zombies, but don't worry, zombies that can come out in the sunlight will move slowly and you will definitely be able to deal with them. However, at night, the truly terrifying zombies will appear. They are even more brutal and strong, and move quickly. They will smell human breath from afar and launch attacks on you and your house in groups. Night is your moment of defense!

Game Mode 2-Infect mode：

You will be responsible for the security work of a survivor safety zone, dealing with sudden mutations of latent carriers of zombie virus. If you don't deal with zombies in a timely manner, the zombie virus will quickly infect everyone.

The survivor safety zone is located on the streets of the city, with many survivors scattered throughout. Over time, the number of survivors in the safety zone has increased, and some survivors are virus carriers in the latent period. Once they mutate into zombies, the entire safety zone will face destruction.

content_descriptors.notes: This game will feature a large number of zombies and bloody scenes of killing zombies, including various firearms and ammunition.
